The referee was forced to manage the flow with several bookings, showing yellow cards to Dylan Gorosito , Tomas Belmonte , and Marco Pellegrino for the home side. Central Cordoba 's Leonardo Sequeira also entered the book as both teams fought fiercely for every ball. Despite the stop-start nature of the final minutes of the half, the hosts remained firmly in control of the scoreline and the tempo. Sealing the Points Boca Juniors continued to press their advantage in the second half, and the decisive blow came in the 56th minute. Carlos Palacios orchestrated a move that allowed Angel Romero to find the net for the second time, effectively ending the contest as a spectacle. While Central Cordoba searched for a lifeline through multiple substitutions, their breakthrough only came in the 90th minute. Martin Cuitino converted a pass from Fernando Martinez to pull one back, but it was nothing more than a consolation as the final whistle confirmed a comprehensive victory for the home side.
